items.name: echo
items.description: Documentarian of the Dreamers — writes and maintains project docs (README, CHANGELOG), Echo-owned sections of `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, and project-specific docs based on recent changes. Spawned by `/dreamers-docs` (standalone) and by `/dreamers` Phase 3 close-out + Phase 2 between cycles (INCREMENTAL).
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: forge
items.description: Coder of the Dreamers — implementation orchestrator persona. Enter via `/agents forge` for a multi-turn session pre-loaded with pipeline knowledge + coding standards. Routes work through plan → implement → close-out and enforces dreamers-kernel.md. NOT a spawned subagent.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: hone
items.description: Architectural protector of the Dreamers — read-only / report-only reviewer of simplicity, over-engineering, bad architecture, redundancy, and simpler alternatives. Writes one `.dreamers/reviews/` artifact. Aggressively surfaces findings even when the fix requires a full refactor; refactor cost is not a moderating factor. Part of the complex per-plan `/dreamers` review gate. The orchestrator gates major-refactor findings through user approval.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: nova
items.description: Planning specialist of the Dreamers — planning persona. Enter via `/agents nova` for a multi-turn planning session. Runs the interactive three-phase requirements conversation with Phase 1A Grill before proposal approval, asks one request_information question at a time with recommended / alternate / Other choices, honors user plan-type override, writes right-sized plan file(s) at `.dreamers/plans/feature-<slug>/plan-NN-<name>.md` (and optional `manifest.md` in the same feature directory), verifies plan coverage against the proposal and user discussion, hard-stops at the approval gate. Never implements / commits / pushes. NOT a spawned subagent.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: probe
items.description: Tester of the Dreamers — read-only / report-only reviewer of test coverage (AC matrix, layer audit, edge + negative cases, regression risk). Writes one `.dreamers/reviews/` artifact. Part of the standard and complex per-plan `/dreamers` review gate.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: sage
items.description: Researcher of the Dreamers — conducts deep, multi-perspective research on any topic. Produces comprehensive, citation-backed reports with verified sources.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: sentinel
items.description: Reviewer of the Dreamers — read-only / report-only reviewer of correctness, security, and maintainability. Writes one `.dreamers/reviews/` artifact. Part of the standard and complex per-plan `/dreamers` review gate and explicit `/dreamers-review` selected lanes. Orchestrator applies fixes.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: vigil
items.description: Single-pass reviewer of the Dreamers. Combines Sentinel, Probe, and the shared Hone architecture rubric for correctness, security, maintainability, test coverage, and simplicity. Used for lite `/dreamers` plans, skill-internal reviews outside `/dreamers` and `/dreamers-review`, and normal `/dreamers` follow-up review reruns. Review-only for code/tests/docs; writes one `.dreamers/reviews/` artifact with a required architecture audit section; never applies fixes.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-add-logging
items.description: Phased pass to add or improve project logging per `logging-standards.md`. Audit → propose → user approval → implement inline → optional Vigil review.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-clean-work
items.description: Between-milestone maintenance pass: prune stale files, audit improvements.md, scan for project-state drift. All inline — no subagents.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-cleanup-comments
items.description: Project-wide comment cleanup pass per `comment-rules.md`. Audit → propose → user approval → apply inline → optional Vigil review.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-cleanup-comments-branch
items.description: Branch-scoped comment cleanup. Same audit-propose-apply-review flow as /dreamers-cleanup-comments, scoped to the current feature-branch diff. For use as a pre-PR comment sweep.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-docs
items.description: Standalone docs-update entry point. Spawns Echo to update Echo-owned sections of `.github/copilot-instructions.md` plus other project docs (README, CHANGELOG, project-specific docs). Resolves diff scope via `--branch` (vs origin/<default>) or `--staged`. Echo stages edits; user commits after review. Does not push or open a PR.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-fix
items.description: Lightweight bug-fix pipeline. Self-contained: cuts fix/<slug> from fresh origin/<default>, writes a regression test, implements inline, runs project tests, and exits at green tests. Next step is Vigil review, then commit + /dreamers-pr. No /dreamers call. On scope blowup, surfaces choice to escalate to /dreamers; does not auto-route.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-find-refactors
items.description: Refactor discovery pipeline. Selects refactor lenses, sections the repo, runs section-scoped Hone audits, synthesizes findings, writes Dreamers plan files using the selected lite / standard / complex guide, and stops. Read-only for project code; no implementation, branch, commit, push, or PR.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers
items.description: End-to-end Dreamers pipeline. Accepts a task description, existing plan path(s), or a feature manifest. Task mode invokes `/dreamers-plan`, then uses the plan review / implementation-start gate; plan path and manifest modes skip planning and that gate. Invokes `/dreamers-implement`, then `/dreamers-review`; review selects reviewers from plan complexity or explicit plan/user direction. The orchestrator applies findings, owns user testing and fix loops, preserves the full close-out gates, invokes `/dreamers-docs`, and invokes `/dreamers-pr`.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-implement
items.description: Standalone implementation entry point. Writes failing tests against the plan's ACs, implements inline, runs tests. Exits at green tests; does NOT review, push, or open a PR. For full pipeline use /dreamers.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-issue
items.description: Create a structured GitHub issue with acceptance criteria from a task description.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-new-project
items.description: Bootstrap a brand new project from scratch: discovery questions, optional existing-solutions research, project brief, shell plans. All work inline.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-plan
items.description: Standalone planning entry point. 3-phase requirements conversation (interactive Hash-out → Write → Review). Runs Phase 1A Grill before proposal approval, asks one request_information question at a time with recommended / alternate / Other choices, honors user plan-type override, selects lite / standard / complex, produces right-sized plan file(s) under .dreamers/plans/feature-<slug>/ and optional manifest, then verifies written-plan coverage against the approved proposal and user discussion. Hard-stops at the review gate; does NOT implement and does NOT invoke any other skill.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-plan-verify
items.description: Inline drift check on a plan against current codebase reality. Reads the plan, verifies cited paths/signatures/data shapes still hold, reports drift items. No subagent.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-pr
items.description: PR creation skill — pushes the current branch, drafts the PR body from the pr-description template, opens the PR via gh, optionally posts an issue resolution comment.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-pr-resolve
items.description: Resolve unresolved PR review comments inline. Orchestrator decides accept/reject per thread, applies fixes, runs required artifact-backed Vigil review of accepted changes, then resolves accepted threads via `gh api`.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-research
items.description: Deep research with phased workflow: scoping, parallel sub-topic research, synthesis, final report.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-review
items.description: Review skill — selects Vigil for lite plans, Sentinel + Probe for standard plans, or Sentinel + Probe + Hone for complex plans unless the plan or user explicitly directs another lane. Reads reviewer `.dreamers/reviews/` artifacts and reports structured findings. Read-only; does NOT apply fixes.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-simplify
items.description: Standalone focused Vigil review for architectural quality / over-engineering / redundancy. Read-only and artifact-backed — may recommend full refactors. Args: --branch, --paths, --all.
items.author: CJ Storrs

items.name: dreamers-test
items.description: Standalone focused Vigil review for test coverage. Read-only and artifact-backed — reports structured findings on AC coverage, layer audit, edge cases, regression risks. Args: --branch, --paths, --all.
items.author: CJ Storrs

collections.name: Dreamers System
collections.description: Agent orchestration system for GitHub Copilot CLI. Pairs artifact-backed specialised reviewers (correctness/security, test coverage, simplicity), the Vigil single-pass reviewer, an implementation skill, a documentarian, and a researcher. The `/dreamers` pipeline preserves the full gates while delegating planning, implementation, review, docs, and PR mechanics to their specialized skills. Review selection is based on plan complexity or explicit plan/user direction. The README at the readmePath has the full detail.
collections.author: CJ Storrs

folderTargets.name: Dreamers Refs
folderTargets.description: Shared reference files used across Dreamers agents and skills (planning protocol, planning Grill phase, testing mandate, comment rules, architecture rubric, git workflow, close-out procedure, orchestrator discipline, etc.).

folderTargets.name: Dreamers Templates
folderTargets.description: Shared templates used by Dreamers skills (plan guide selector, lite/standard/complex plan guides, feature manifest, GitHub issue, PR description, project brief, user testing gate, logging standards, etc.).

folderTargets.name: Instructions
folderTargets.description: Shared instruction files (e.g. comment rules) consumed by Dreamers agents and skills.
